## Description
The last-commit header always shows the very latest commit, not the last commit within the viewed directory, as it did in 1.13.x

![grafik](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/7880552/112012238-ef9a1900-8b20-11eb-9c70-f52ca08cd237.png)

review_comments: `ctx.Repo.Commit` means currently browsing commit, not the treepath dir last commit
Hmm, I think it's okay, Because when browsing a treepath, the last commit of this path is more usefull than last commit of current branch or tag. And it's same with gh.
